instruction: Find the maximum age value in the ODS spreadsheet using command line tools, and save it to /home/user/Desktop/max_age.txt

metadata.explanation: Task requires using command line to find maximum age (column F) from ODS file and save to text file. Expected value verified with Python: maximum age is 58 (100 people have this age). Evaluator reads the result file and checks if numeric value matches.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts file content from the specified path using cat command with appropriate error handling
Metric logic correctly parses numeric value from string result and compares with expected value (58) using tolerance-based comparison
Parameter handling is correct: metric function receives rules dict directly when expected.type='rule', and correctly accesses expected.get('value')
Expected value (58) is semantically correct and verified as the maximum age from the ODS file per metadata explanation
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (maximum age value saved to file)
State accessibility: file will exist after task completion, postconfig appropriately cleans up terminal
Edge cases handled: getter returns empty string if file doesn't exist, metric returns 0.0 for invalid/missing data
